explanation: The default value `LIGHTNING_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` is evaluated once at module import time, so if the environment variable is set after the module is loaded, the default will be `None` and the project_id filtering logic will be bypassed, silently falling through to the multi-membership path instead of filtering by the intended project ID.
